brief_rationale: The trajectory successfully navigated a complex acute pediatric case with significant real-world barriers. All responsibility chain items were met with appropriate clinical reasoning and safety recognition. Multiple high-order points were completed with meaningful impact: the doctor overcame the family's initial hesitation about immediate ED evaluation (HO2), navigated cost/transport barriers by directing to nearest pediatric ED rather than distant original hospital (HO1), and maintained state-sensitive communication throughout (HO3). Safe closure was achieved with clear escalation criteria and follow-up guidance.

closure_assessment.explanation: Episode safely closed after successful ED evaluation, IV hydration, and clinical improvement. Clear observation parameters, escalation criteria, and deferred follow-up for non-acute issues. Family demonstrated understanding of the plan.
